'''Mari''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] daughter of a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] named [[Galron (Mandalorian)|Galron]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. She lived with her twin sister [[Tayn]] and their parents on the moon of [[Concordia/Legends|Concordia]], where their father and [[Galron's wife|mother]] raised and trained them to become Mandalorians. One day, Galron took the girls out to hunt on the plains, after which they sey out a camp for the night. Before nighttime, Galron told his daughters the stories about [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]] and [[Mandalore the Conqueror]].
